These docs are for agents. Start with the onboarding prompt.
- [Onboarding prompt](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/onboarding-prompt.md): copy-paste agent block (entry point for agents).
- [Getting started](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/getting-started.md): first preview in one sitting.
- [Adopting a repo](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/adopting-a-repo.md): write .sprout.yaml and the app entrypoint.
- [CI integration](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/ci-integration.md): GitLab component, GitHub reusable workflow, variables, reset, notes.
- [Previews](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/previews.md): lifecycle: database providers, seeding, services, mail.
- [Operator deploy](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/operator-deploy.md): gateway compose stack, Traefik, env reference, admin token.
- [CLI reference](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/cli-reference.md): every sprout command, debugging, tokens.
- [Troubleshooting](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/troubleshooting.md): symptom → fix catalogue for adopters and operators.
- [Telemetry](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/telemetry.md): what is sent, what it costs, how to stop it.
- [Herdr integration](https://simpros.github.io/sprout/docs/herdr-integration.md): operator-side review automation.
